parameters.jsCode: const parseRec=(v)=>{if(typeof v==='string'){try{return JSON.parse(v);}catch(e){return null;}} return (v&&typeof v==='object')?v:null;}; const j=$input.first().json; const now=Date.now(); const out=[]; for(const k of Object.keys(j||{})){ if(k.indexOf('remind:')!==0) continue; const rec=parseRec(j[k]); if(!rec||!rec.appointmentISO) continue; const appt=Date.parse(rec.appointmentISO); if(isNaN(appt)) continue; const rAt=Number(rec.remindedAt)||null; const confAt=Number(rec.confirmedAt)||null; const fresh=confAt!==null&&rAt!==null&&confAt>rAt; const future=appt>now; const who=rec.patientName||'patient'; const svc=rec.serviceName||rec.service||'visit'; if(!!rAt&&!fresh&&future&&now>rAt+120000){out.push({patient:who,service:svc,appointmentISO:rec.appointmentISO,reason:'unconfirmed_reminder',detail:'Reminded, no reply within 2 minutes — nurse call due'});} else if(!rAt&&future&&now>appt-2*3600*1000){out.push({patient:who,service:svc,appointmentISO:rec.appointmentISO,reason:'remind_due',detail:'Confirmation window reached, no reminder sent yet'});} } return [{json:{total:out.length,items:out.slice(0,20)}}];
